title: Product-repo registry
description: state/impl-repos.json — the one registry of product repos the pipeline knows. Keys are short repo names under the example-org org. Every key must have guards/<repo>.paths and every guards file must have a key; schema-validate enforces both. Only routable:true repos receive routed tickets from ticket-intake.

routable.description: ticket-intake may route repo:<name> tickets here

visibility.description: public repos get strip-attribution + footprint-scan on every push
